scope: Construction of two explicitly selected cast-in-place rectangular reinforced-concrete wastewater process tanks STT-RC-2X18X8X5-WT for equalization and primary-settlement duty, each 18 m by 8 m with 5 m operating liquid depth, including 260 m of PVC-P-320 waterstop. Direct earthworks, concrete, reinforcement, formwork, joints, waterproofing, protective coating, embedded items, penetrations, access, drainage, consumables, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved wastewater structural and process designer, concrete and waterproofing specifications, waterstop supplier, testing laboratory and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: complete treatment plant, aeration grid, process equipment, sludge dewatering, septic facility or external networks
earthwork, concrete, reinforcement, formwork, waterproofing, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from tank count or dimensions
automatic excavation shoring, groundwater dewatering or odor cover
universal retained spare or supplier-coil length
